protocol: Same class, confidence descending, one-to-one IoU>=0.5; matched IoU excludes unmatched. A and B reported separately.
threshold_sweep_note: Filters cached candidates from the original threshold 0.30. It cannot recover candidates below 0.30.
trial_note: Prompt tuning on a seeded class-stratified training subset only, not independent test performance; human references retain disagreements.
scope: Actual training-set annotation diagnosis; not independent test performance, training accuracy, human accuracy, or labor saving.

cache_reproduction.scope: Selected training images only; comparison tolerance IoU>=0.999 and score delta<=0.0001

catalog_mutation: None: read-only SQLite; new trial outputs saved under artifacts only. Active human reviews may continue independently.
